channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: 'Malaysia is still proud of you': Tengku Zafrul tells Aaron-Wooi Yik
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Badminton Association of Malaysia (BAM) president Tengku Datuk Seri Zafrul Abdul Aziz has urged Aaron Chia-Soh Wooi Yik to keep their heads high after their latest All England heartbreak, saying reaching three finals is already a notable achievement.

item.title: Emulate Azizulhasni, avoid social media trap, Beasley tells young riders
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: John Beasley has highlighted Azizulhasni Awang as the ideal model professional while cautioning young athletes about the distractions of social media.

item.title: 'Back to square one': Gazans despair as key crossing remains closed
item.description: WHEN Israel reopened Gaza’s Rafah border crossing in early February, Fadi Emad thought his chance had finally come to leave the devastated Palestinian territory and finish his studies abroad.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Shahida opens up about son's ADHD: 'He has no sense of fear'
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The wife of entrepreneur and sometime singer Datuk Seri Aliff Syukri, Datin Seri Shahida Mohd Rashid, recently revealed that their fourth child, Yusoff Al Qardawi, has been diagnosed with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD).

item.title: 'Chapeau to Awang' - Richardson admits he was left stunned by Azizulhasni
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Great Britain star Matthew Richardson admitted that he was caught completely off guard by Azizulhasni Awang's last-gasp overtake at the UCI World Cup series in Perth.

item.title: Syawal moon sighting at 29 locations nationwide on March 19
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The sighting of the Syawal new moon to determine the date of Hari Raya Aidilfitri will take place at 29 locations nationwide on March 19, the Office of the Keeper of the Rulers’ Seal announced today.

item.title: Perlis to give RM1,500 Aidilfitri aid to state civil servants
item.description: KANGAR: The Perlis government has announced a RM1,500 special Aidilfitri financial assistance (BKKA) for 2026.

item.title: Two men plead not guilty to injuring policeman in Kuantan
item.description: KUANTAN: Two men pleaded not guilty at the magistrate’s court here to a charge of hurting a policeman.

item.title: CCTV installed at Bukit Kiara Park after Teresa Kok's car break-in
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Closed-circuit television (CCTV) cameras have been installed around Bukit Kiara Federal Park following appeals by Seputeh MP Teresa Kok, after her car was recently broken into at the park’s parking area.

item.title: Australian shares lose $138 billion in value as oil surge stokes inflation fears
item.description: SYDNEY: Australian shares slumped about three per cent on Monday, erasing over US$138 billion in value in their worst session since last April's "Liberation Day" tariff shock, as a spike in oil prices driven by the Middle East war stoked concerns of a breakout in global inflation.
